explication: AstrBot is a multi-platform chatbot and agent platform. A user message enters through a messaging-platform adapter, is handled by the event pipeline, routed to an agent or extension, and returned as a platform response. The repository also exposes a WebUI, knowledge-base retrieval, plugin and skill extensions, MCP/tool integrations, and sandboxed computer capabilities. Paths and subsystem responsibilities are supported by the tree and README; sampled source was limited, so detailed wiring beyond the documented runtime stages is not inferred.
